# Pull Request

## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Related Issues

- Fixes #(issue)
- Relates to #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring / Code quality

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the coding style and guidelines of this project (`uv run ruff format` and `uv run ruff check`).
- [ ] Strict type checking passes (`uv run mypy src tests`).
- [ ] Radon complexity standards are met (`uv run python scripts/check_radon.py src`).
- [ ] I have added unit tests for new functionality / bug fixes.
- [ ] Test suite and coverage requirements pass (`uv run pytest`).
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly.
